GMB.note: Document concerns tax administration, not e-procurement.
No consumer protection rules or redress stated.
ITAS is described as introduced ahead of full rollout, not as a tax system in use.
ITAS is a tax agency's own system, not a government services portal.
No government payments to people stated.
Taxpayer workshop concerns a tax system, not a named digital law or policy.

facts.fact: The Gambia Revenue Authority says its new ITAS, being introduced ahead of full rollout, will let taxpayers file returns and make payments online (e-filing, e-payment).

systems.platform: World Bank-funded Public Administration Modernisation for Citizen-Centric Service Delivery Project

facts.fact: The Gambia Revenue Authority and Ministry of Finance introduced a new Integrated Tax Administration System with e-registration, e-filing and e-payment at a stakeholder workshop, with taxpayer input sought before full implementation.
